blockers.description: Local bash stdout intermittently DROPS and DOUBLES output; multi-step bash blocks have silently no-op'd
blockers.workaround: write output to /tmp and Read it; run risky git mutations as SINGLE steps; verify every result against the REMOTE (gh / git cat-file -e) before the next step. Never treat empty output as success.

blockers.description: Killed workflows leave locked git worktrees under .claude/worktrees/
blockers.workaround: git worktree remove <path> -f -f; git worktree prune (remove BEFORE gh pr merge --delete-branch or branch-delete fails)
